relationships.subject: cisplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: cisplatin treatment alone decreased Oprd1 mRNA levels in the DRG, whereas treatment with the HDAC6 inhibitor normalized expression of Oprd1 in both sexes

relationships.subject: ACY-1083
relationships.evidence_quote: cisplatin treatment alone decreased Oprd1 mRNA levels in the DRG, whereas treatment with the HDAC6 inhibitor normalized expression of Oprd1 in both sexes

relationships.subject: ACY-1083
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of the HDAC6 inhibitor ACY-1083 (10 mg/kg/d, i.p., 14 d) starting 3 d after the last dose of cisplatin resulted in long-lasting reversal of mechanical hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: delta opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that DOR expression in sensory neurons mediates the persistent reversal of cisplatin-induced mechanical hypersensitivity by HDAC6 inhibition.

relationships.subject: enkephalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, these results suggest that enkephalin-DOR signaling maintains persistent reversal of cisplatin-induced hypersensitivity after HDAC6 inhibition in mice of both sexes.

key_findings: HDAC6 inhibition reverses cisplatin hypersensitivity via tonic enkephalin-DOR signaling in peripheral sensory neurons (latent sensitization).
Cisplatin lowers Oprd1 expression in DRG neurons, normalized by the HDAC6 inhibitor; DOR deletion in advillin+ neurons abolishes the reversal.
